ei.title: Culture Notes - Protecting Elves, Protecting Nature
ei.subject: 공통영어1

fullPassage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!

questions.passage: Elves have ①<u>been</u> an ③<u>important</u> part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these ②<u>imagining</u> beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about ④<u>digging</u> up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 아이슬란드인들의 이 상상의 존재에 대한 관심.
det.analysis:
✅ ① been: 현재완료 'have been' — 적절.
❌ ② imagining: 원문 'imaginary'. 명사 beings를 수식하는 형용사 자리이므로 imaginary(상상의)가 맞음. imagining(동명사/현재분사)은 부적절. ←정답
✅ ③ important: 형용사 보어 — 적절.
✅ ④ digging: 전치사 about + 동명사 — 적절.
det.tip: imaginary(형용사: 상상의) vs imagining(동명사: 상상하는 행위).

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for ①<u>centuries</u>, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves ②<u>exist</u> among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and ③<u>protecting</u> rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes ④<u>changed</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 바위와 언덕을 존중하고 보호하는 것이 중요하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① centuries: 복수명사 — 적절.
✅ ② exist: 원형동사(that절 내 주어 elves에 수일치) — 적절.
❌ ③ protecting: 원문 'to respect and protect'. to부정사와 병렬 연결(to respect and protect)이므로 동사원형 protect가 맞음. ←정답
✅ ④ changed: 수동태 'are sometimes changed' — 적절.
det.tip: to A and B: to + 동사원형 병렬. to respect and protect(O) / to respect and protecting(X).

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders ①<u>like</u> to imagine that elves exist among ②<u>them</u>. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's ③<u>beautiful</u> natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is ④<u>being protecting</u>!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 엘프 덕분에 자연이 보호받고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① like: 동사 'like to imagine' — 적절.
✅ ② them: 대명사(elves를 받음) — 적절.
✅ ③ beautiful: 형용사 — 적절.
❌ ④ being protecting: 원문 'is being protected'. 진행형 수동태 'is being + p.p.' 구조에서 protected(과거분사)가 와야 함. protecting(현재분사)은 불가. ←정답
det.tip: 진행형 수동태: be + being + p.p. → is being protected(O) / is being protecting(X).

det.korean: 아이슬란드인들의 관심이 그들에게 자연과의 감정적 연결을 준다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① give: 원문 'Icelanders' interest ... gives them'. 주어 interest(단수)이므로 gives가 맞음. give(복수 동사)는 수일치 오류. ←정답
✅ ② homes: 복수명사 — 적절.
✅ ③ twice: 부사 'think twice' — 적절.
✅ ④ sometimes: 빈도부사 — 적절.
det.tip: 주어 interest(단수) → gives(3인칭 단수). Icelanders'(소유격)에 속지 말 것.

det.korean: 바위와 언덕을 존중하고 보호해야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① important: '중요한' — 적절.
✅ ② emotional: '감정적인' — 적절.
❌ ③ neglect: '무시하다' — 원문 respect(존중하다). 엘프의 집인 바위를 '무시한다'는 문맥에 반대. ←정답
✅ ④ beautiful: '아름다운' — 적절.
det.tip: respect(존중하다) ↔ neglect(무시하다).

✅ ③ landscapes: '경관' — 적절.
✅ ④ construction: '건설' — 적절.
det.tip: connection(연결) ↔ disconnection(단절).

det.analysis:
✅ ④ emotional: 원문 'an emotional connection to nature.' 감정적 연결.
❌ ① financial: '재정적' — 문맥과 무관.

det.korean: 사람들은 아름다운 자연 경관을 파헤치는 것을 다시 생각한다.

❌ ② traditions: '전통' — digging up과 맞지 않음.
❌ ③ celebrations: '축제' — 문맥과 무관.
❌ ④ populations: '인구' — 문맥과 무관.

✅ ③ 일치: 'plans ... are sometimes changed.'
✅ ④ 일치: 'an emotional connection to nature.'
det.tip: think twice = 다시 생각하다, 주저하다 ≠ 장려하다.

ch: 아이슬란드인들은 엘프가 자기들 사이에 존재한다고 상상하기를 좋아한다.

questions.passage: Therefore, people think twice about __________. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (7단어) (영어로)
"나라의 아름다운 자연 경관을 파헤치는 것"
[조건] (1) digging, up, the, country's, beautiful, natural, landscapes를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 나라의 아름다운 자연 경관을 파헤치는 것.
det.analysis: 'people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.'에서 about 뒤 부분.
det.tip: dig up = 파헤치다. 동명사 digging up + 목적어.
